description: This file contains Swift unit tests for the MenuSessionsInjector class related to menu manipulation and session management in a macOS application.

methods.name: anchorsDynamicRowsBelowControlsAndActions
methods.description: Tests whether the injector correctly finds insert positions for menu items near control and action rows.

methods.name: injectsDisconnectedMessage
methods.description: Tests injecting a disconnected message into the menu when the control channel is not connected.

methods.name: injectsSessionRows
methods.description: Tests injection of session rows into the menu when the control channel is connected.

methods.name: cost usage submenu does not use injector delegate
methods.description: Verifies that the cost usage submenu does not adopt the injector delegate.
